dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Right, there you are! All your Xiao Lantern parts, crafted to order, and every piece individually waterproofed.

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Each is wrapped in five to six layers of oilpaper, so you could toss 'em in a pond to soak for a week or so and they'd still be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Thank you for your diligence. Rest assured, I shall compensate you for your labor and expenditures in full. After all, procuring all this when it isn't Lantern Rite must be quite the hassle.

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: It was nothing, really! No need to be so polite! Doing business means always putting the customer's needs first and foremost!

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Oh, right! How did you find the tea you bought last time? Could I interest you in some Chenyu Adeptea as well? We just got a new batch in, freshly dried! Top-notch stuff, every leaf!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I see. If there's a discount, then...

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Right, there you are! All your Xiao Lantern parts, crafted to order, and every piece individually waterproofed.

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Each is wrapped in five to six layers of oilpaper, so you could toss 'em in a pond to soak for a week or so and they'd still be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: My thanks for your diligence. Rest assured, I shall compensate you for your labor and expenditures in full.

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Come on, my good fellow! No need to be so polite! Doing business means always putting the customer's needs first and foremost!

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Oh, right! How did you find the tea you bought last time? Could I interest you in some Chenyu Adeptea as well? We just got a new batch in, freshly dried! Top-notch stuff, every leaf!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I see. If there's a discount, then...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold it right there, Neuvillette! You can't go buying stuff just 'cause they say there's a discount!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You didn't even finish the tea you bought last time!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}? Paimon? Now this is a coincidence. I had just been wondering if you would come to Liyue Harbor for the festival. I wish you a happy Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, were you buying Xiao Lantern parts just now? And you even had him waterproof them, so does that mean...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Yes. I intend to gift these to the Melusines. They have never seen such lanterns before, and I'm sure they'll enjoy them.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I would still like to buy a few more to hang outside the Palais Mermonia. However, doing so would create a dilemma: Would it not be unfair that the Palais Mermonia is the only place with Xiao Lanterns?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Perhaps I should return and have the Gestionnaires make a bulk purchase, so Xiao Lanterns can be hung over the entire Court of Fontaine and Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: If you let the Gestionnaires handle it, we'll be lucky to hang up any Lanterns they buy before next year's Lantern Rite rolls around.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Also, point of caution, Your Honor — it might not be the best idea to hang them in Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: They won't fly high within our walls, and I doubt many of the wishes the inmates'll write will have a chance of coming true.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: They're unlikely to wish for anything in the public interest, anyway. Let's try and keep the Lanterns' reputation clean, yeah?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: And as for the "good wishes" worth making, I've already sent them soaring on the inmates' behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Heh, Lantern Festival's positively packed this year!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Oh, right. Happy Lantern Rite, everyone. Don't mind if I address you as a group, it's the thought that counts anyway.

choices.text: Now, now, tradition dictates and all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! What's up with the "too" that Paimon got?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: #Heh, Wriothesley, Miss Sigewinne, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. Allow me to wish you all a happy Lantern Rite as well.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: This festival is wonderful indeed, to have brought us all together.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: #Whoa, now this really feels like a party. Shame I didn't buy any of those Fortune Coin packets — otherwise, Liyue custom would've obliged us to hand one each to {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A direct Mora injection into my coffers wouldn't hurt...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Hahaha, fine by me! Let's go grab something good later, I'm sure Paimon can lead the way!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Haha, then Paimon's gonna go all out on the menu!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Won't you please join us as well, Monsieur Neuvillette?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Of course, I'm more than willing.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Hey, I just noticed... That's a sharp new outfit you've got there. Goes perfectly with the holiday cheer... and that relaxed expression you're wearing.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Hmm, Monsieur Neuvillette, looking at the weave and the ornamentation... If I'm not mistaken, this is Melusine handiwork.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You can tell?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Yep! Looking at the design, I'd say it's one of Flo's creations. Laume probably contributed a lot, too.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Anyway, it's dashing and elegant, and suits Monsieur Neuvillette well.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Indeed. This is a most precious gift the Melusines have given me.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Neuvillette recounts how the Melusines gave him his new outfit...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So, you're planning to give them Xiao Lanterns as a thank-you?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Yes. It is only polite to do so.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: You can expect another thank-you gift from them, then.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Yes, I suppose they will do that.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Fair enough, gifts are gifts, after all. If your office starts drowning in them, though, you can send the overflow my way.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: My head nurse here is excellent at taking care of Melusine gifts.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Hehe, leave it to me! I'll preserve their sentiments perfectly.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But first, why don't we find another place to stretch our legs?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Liyue's a beautiful place, and has a flavor completely unlike anything we're used to in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And I'm not just talking about the tea, mind you.

choices.text: Happy Lantern Rite to you too, Paimon!
